about.title: Full-Stack Software Developer
about.bioP1: I am Saeed Mohammed Omer Ba-gnanh, a full-stack software developer based in Mukalla, Yemen. I build backend systems, APIs, and database-backed applications with a strong focus on clarity, reliability, and maintainability.
about.bioP2: I hold a B.S. in Computer Information Systems from Al-Ahgaff University (2019–2023). My technical work spans Laravel, Django, Python, FastAPI, ASP.NET, JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL, Flutter, and Dart.
about.philosophyP1: I treat software engineering as a practical discipline: understand the product, design clear boundaries, protect data, and keep delivery maintainable. Good systems make the next change easier, not more dangerous.
